description: This file contains unit tests for validating XML configuration files against a DTD in the OpenMRS module. It uses JUnit 5 parameterized tests to check various scenarios on XML files, including version compatibility and module awareness.

classes.name: ModuleConfigDTDTest_V1_4
classes.description: JUnit test class for validating module configuration XML files against a DTD, testing different versions and module setups.

methods.name: validXmlWithMultipleAwareOfModules
methods.description: Tests that an XML with multiple 'awareOfModules' elements and compatible version passes validation.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Converts a DOM Document to a formatted XML string.

methods.name: validXmlWithMissingVersion
methods.description: Tests that an XML with missing version attribute but valid modules still passes validation.

methods.name: xmlFailsWithNoModules
methods.description: Tests that an XML with no 'awareOfModules' elements fails validation.

methods.name: getCompatibleVersions
methods.description: Provides a stream of version arguments to parameterized tests.
